_comment: PRIVATE CLIENT WORKSPACE settings for the local-service-launch kit. Not for this repo. INSTALL: (1) copy this file to <workspace>/.claude/settings.json; (2) copy hooks/block-send-publish.sh to <workspace>/.claude/hooks/block-send-publish.sh and run chmod +x on it; (3) start Claude Code in <workspace>, accept the workspace trust dialog, and run /permissions to confirm the deny and ask rules loaded with no warnings; (4) run the DRY-RUN commands in the hook header and log the exit codes in the Day 1-3 checklist. PLACEHOLDERS: none are required; the mcp__* globs match connector tool names across servers regardless of how your install names the server. If /permissions or claude doctor warns that a deny rule matches no known tool, that connector is not connected; the rule is harmless and can stay. HOW IT ENFORCES: deny beats ask beats allow, and a deny rule cannot be overridden by any other scope. The PreToolUse hook exits 2 on send/publish/share/delete tool names and on edits to truth-ledger.md and product-marketing-context.md; a hook exit 2 blocks before permission rules run, so the ask rules below are a second layer in case the hook is not installed. Path rules must use Edit(...): Claude Code consults Edit(path) and Read(path) rules only, and Edit rules cover the Write tool. MCP rules with parentheses are skipped, so no parameter matching on connector tools. Bash(git push *) matches only the literal form; the hook and the VA scope are the other layers. VERIFY against code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions and code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks before use (fetched 2026-09-10). Delete this _comment key if your Claude Code version flags it as an unrecognized setting.
